nameEn: Manufacture of vegetable and animal oils and fats
description: This class includes the manufacture of crude and refined oils and fats from vegetable or animal materials, except rendering or refining of lard and other edible animal fats.
includes: manufacture of crude vegetable oils: olive oil, soya-bean oil, palm oil, sunflower-seed oil, cotton-seed oil, rape, colza or mustard oil, linseed oil, etc.
manufacture of refined vegetable oils: olive oil, soya-bean oil, palm oil, sunflower-seed oil, cotton-seed oil, rape, colza or mustard oil, linseed oil, etc.
manufacture of non-defatted flour or meal of oil seeds, oilnuts or oil kernels
manufacture of animal oils and fats from fish or marine mammals
manufacture of lard and other edible animal fats
manufacture of degras, residues of oil processing
excludes: rendering of lard and other edible animal fat, see 1010
treatment of oil for industrial purposes, see 2029
